test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'JMOP' is related to 'GJLM' in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, 'EHJK' is related to 'BEGH'. To which of the following is 'DGIJ' related, following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e7e71d2372a51969ecd8ffb0fcd69d6cec35b5422d9394cf5f7800f5633fdda.png] ​

**Logic: '3' is subtracted from the positional value of each alphabet.**

JMOP is related to GJLM →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/007d1d9d7df6cac59ab2dd5cbf704f584264f8e9918c3b3ce16f214666539ed2.png] 

EHJK is related to BEGH →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7b03eb7b20569f7662c12489649a6b60bee1fdb5b73b55a15be1788b11bb435.png] 

Similarly, 'DGIJ' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad99f4ccefc0549c5fd2146939f4c1395eefcc2c5c66ea43edaf2f7bc5671684.png] 

Here, 'DGIJ' is related to** 'ADFG'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
